stance_basis: questioned decisions about I-94 construction timing and land acquisition for air cargo area, implying skepticism toward the project
summary: Robert Kernler, a private citizen, questioned why the Airport Spur was not built when I-94 was originally constructed in 1965-1966 and why the Grange Avenue overpass was built with a boulevard. He also questioned the acquisition of 125 land parcels and demolition of homes prior to the public hearing, suggesting concern about the process and decisions surrounding the project.
complaint_summary: Kernler questioned decisions made at the time I-94 was constructed and the acquiring of 60 acres for the air cargo area, and specifically why the Airport Spur wasn't built when I-94 was constructed in 1965-1966 and why the Grange Avenue overpass was built with a boulevard.
